result.summary: This PR relaxes constraints originally placed on external-signer wallets: disable_private_keys is no longer mandatory (though still default), and the external_signer flag becomes mutable and triggers a wallet reload when toggled. It also fixes createwallet's blank-wallet behavior for signer wallets, avoids routing signing through createTransaction for external signers (to not break the GUI), and creates the correct ScriptPubKeyMan variant immediately on descriptor import instead of requiring a reload. Test coverage is added for spending from an imported hot-key descriptor in an otherwise external-signer wallet.
result.problem: The external_signer flag currently forces watch-only, private-keys-disabled wallets and cannot be changed after creation, which works for the single hardware-wallet use case but blocks multisig setups where the wallet also holds a hot key alongside an external signer, a configuration needed for the author's planned MuSig2 support (Sjors/bitcoin#91).

resolved_concerns: jeanpablojp found that toggling the external_signer flag left stale ScriptPubKeyMans that broke walletdisplayaddress and signing; author added an automatic wallet reload on flag change to fix it.

PraneethGunas found that a hot-key descriptor in a signer wallet went straight to the (unreachable) external device and failed to sign; author added logic to sign with the wallet's own keys first and only fall back to the external signer if still unsigned, confirmed fixed by PraneethGunas.
jeanpablojp noted that setting the flag on a build without ENABLE_EXTERNAL_SIGNER left the wallet stuck; author added a compile-guard.
Multiple nits on commit messages and duplicated test helpers (rkrux, w0xlt) were addressed by the author across force-pushes.
gcc maybe-uninitialized CI failure was fixed per maflcko's suggestion using value_or(false).

result.card: This PR relaxes hard constraints on Bitcoin Core's external_signer wallet flag: disable_private_keys is no longer mandatory, and the flag becomes mutable (triggering an automatic wallet reload), so a wallet can combine an external signer with a hot key. The stated motivation is to unblock a planned MuSig2 multisig feature (Sjors/bitcoin#91) that needs exactly this combination. During review, hardware testers (jeanpablojp, PraneethGunas) found and the author fixed real signing bugs: stale ScriptPubKeyMans after toggling the flag, and hot-key inputs incorrectly routed to an unreachable external device; both were confirmed fixed. Concept ACKs came from maintainer achow101 and contributors naiyoma and jeanpablojp, with Tested ACKs from PraneethGunas and adyshimony after live hardware testing. The PR is actively maintained (last force-push 2026-09-14) and conflicts at the file level with two other open PRs (#36114, #35358) without a stated hard dependency.
